summary: One line was denied: the $168.00 office visit (99214), which was bundled into the same-day knee arthrocentesis because modifier 25 was missing. The note documents separate diabetes management (A1c ordered, metformin increased, foot exam), so this looks recoverable through a replacement claim with modifier 25, with no appeal needed. Lines 1 and 3 were paid, and nothing denied appears unrecoverable.

findings.explanation: The office visit was billed on the same day as the knee joint injection without modifier 25, so the payer bundled it into the procedure (CO-97/M15). The note shows a separate diabetes visit beyond the pre-procedure knee evaluation, which supports modifier 25.

evidence.quote: The E/M line must carry modifier 25. Without modifier 25 the E/M service is bundled into the procedure and denied with CARC 97.
To correct the denial, submit a replacement claim with modifier 25 on the E/M line. An appeal is not required.
Type 2 diabetes with hyperglycemia, not at goal. A1c ordered. Metformin increased to 1000 mg twice daily. Diabetic foot exam completed. Follow-up in 3 months.
Follow-up of type 2 diabetes. Reports home glucose readings of 180 to 220.
